instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace plain text emails with a rich, modern, responsive table-based HTML email containing SAGE University and EUPHORIA branding, participant details, date, venue, status pill, prominent CTA to view the online digital pass, and gate instructions.

2. Replace QR-only attachments with a complete, colourful, printable mobile-ticket PDF that embeds the full pass design: official logos, participant name, event name, registration number, category badge, event schedule/venue, security barcode/QR with guaranteed white quiet zone, and gate rules.

3. Upgrade the frontend React digital pass into an ultra-attractive, vibrant youth-festival ticket (modeled with ticket notches, neon accents #FF007A / #7928CA / #06B6D4, holographic foil effect, live scan bar, and one-click PDF download & email trigger).
4. Provide an interactive live preview playground on the frontend allowing testing of the React Pass, HTML Email view, and PDF pass download with test sample attendee data.
5. Ensure strict QR contrast (solid black QR modules on clean white box with >=16px quiet zone) so physical scanner guns and phone cameras work with 100% reliability at festival gates.
6. Keep SAGE University and EUPHORIA branding authentic and prominent across all 3 channels (React app, HTML email, PDF attachment).
